messages.text: Does it have WiFi or must be connected to Ethernet ? Hammer Miner Thor P2
Read the hammer miner thor p2 page
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner Thor P2

Both. The T. P2 does WiFi on 2.4 GHz or Ethernet, your choice. Note it won't join a 5 GHz network, so if your router splits bands, point it at the 2.4 GHz one. Ethernet is the steadier option if the unit sits far from the router.

It's $379 right now, 10 TH/s at about 166 W, around 40 dB. Want me to set up a cart for you?

Does it need to be overclocked to run 10TH/s? Or what is it out the box ?

No overclock needed. The listing's ~10 TH/s at ~166 W is the stock figure, that's what it does out of the box on the two BM1373 chips.

Worth knowing: overclocking voids the warranty on our units, so I'd leave it at stock. Real-world hashrate wanders a bit with room temperature and airflow, so give it some breathing space.
